findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption request, including the managed seed object, may be stored without encryption at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not encrypt exported ledger data stored in the bucket.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect model artifact contents from being stored unencrypted.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. The private ACL and versioning settings do not provide encryption for runbook content at rest.

This object is uploaded to reports_archive, which has no default bucket encryption, and the object does not request server-side encryption. The vendor roster may therefore be stored unencrypted at rest.
